rule: Tickets are sold in the online ticket shop (ksc.de/tickets, tickets.ksc.de), from the day after the online start also in the FanWelt at the BBBank Wildpark and the Fanshop am Rondellplatz, and on matchday at the stadium box offices when tickets remain. Buying online needs a KSC-ID, a free registration with name, e-mail, address and date of birth; one e-mail address per KSC-ID.

Membership is not required for an ordinary home game, which reaches free sale. A passive adult membership (Klassik, 18+) costs EUR 75 a year from 1 Jul 2026 (EUR 70 reduced, EUR 90 Premium); 7-17 year-olds pay EUR 40; 0-6 year-olds are free but get no presale right. Membership starts once the application is processed and confirmed by e-mail, which currently takes up to 30 working days; the member's KSC-ID is then unlocked for members' presales.
note: ONE SOURCE, the club's own membership page; no second source for the fee was found. The club plans EUR 90 for every adult from July 2027 (EUR 80 with Supporters Karlsruhe membership). For the derby a membership is the practical route in (see free-sale-reached): two people need two memberships, since a KSC-ID carries one presale right. The processing time matters: an application made only when the sale is announced may not be processed in time.

rule: One presale right per KSC-ID: buying several season tickets on one KSC-ID still gives one right. Children's (0-6) and corporate memberships carry none.

note: ID on request is ATGB clause 2.6. Season tickets are always personalised (ATGB 4.1).

rule: The club's own Ticketzweitmarkt is the only legal platform for reselling and buying KSC home tickets. rule: The ticket terms forbid offering tickets on unauthorised platforms (named: viagogo, StubHub, Ticketbande, Gigsberg, eBay, eBay Kleinanzeigen, Facebook, seatwave) even without profit, and passing a ticket on above the original price; a mark-up of up to 15% for transaction costs is allowed. Tickets offered on unauthorised platforms can be cancelled without compensation.
note: ATGB 10.2. A private handover (illness, being prevented) is allowed under ATGB 10.3 through the Zweitmarkt or with the club told who the new holder is. The Landgericht Mannheim prohibited viagogo from selling unauthorised KSC tickets (K34, a legal blog's account, Jan 2026).

rule: Tickets come as print@home or mobile tickets with a 2D code. A home ticket includes travel on the whole VVS network from seven hours before the game to 5:00 the next morning; a print@home ticket needs the VVS ticket fetched separately.

rule: A ticket may be passed on privately for non-commercial reasons, for example illness: through the club's Zweitmarkt, or directly if the new holder accepts the terms and the club is told, on request, the new holder's name, address and date of birth. rule: The club's own Ticketbörse is the only legal resale route. Day tickets can be listed only for sold-out games, from one week before; season-ticket seats from two weeks before. The ticket is blocked and re-released; other fans buy it at the official price through the regular sale, and the seller is refunded the price minus a 20% handling fee.
note: The Ticketbörse for day tickets is new from 2025-26 (V1). The ATGB say only that the seller is credited the original price less costs (V11). DOES NOT SIT EASILY WITH GERMANY'S DFL ROW (country-ticket-rules.csv, resale-price-cap): the DFL's fair-play rules cap the service fee for the official secondary market at 15% of the order value, and VfB keeps 20% from the seller. Either VfB is not one of the clubs in the DFL scheme (the DFL page does not say every club takes part), or the 15% means a buyer-side fee. Not settled; nothing changed on either side.

rule: Offering a ticket at auctions, on unauthorised platforms (named: eBay, eBay Kleinanzeigen, seatwave, viagogo, StubHub, ticketbande, ticketbis) or on social media is forbidden, as is any commercial resale. Tickets offered on unauthorised platforms give no right of entry, and the club pursues sellers with contractual penalties.

rule: Season tickets 2026/27 are sold only online, on TicketOne (sscnapoli.ticketone.it, the club's "Biglietti" section). After purchase the seat voucher (tagliando/segnaposto) is e-mailed and can be printed again from TicketOne's post-order page; online buyers can pay in instalments.

rule: A valid Fidelity Card is required to renew or buy a 2026/27 season ticket. A card that expires during the season must be replaced, and titles move to the new card automatically if the data match (about 24 hours) or by hand on TicketOne. A lost or broken card cannot be duplicated: a new card is needed (after a police report if lost), then titles are transferred. Minors can get a card if a parent signs the procedure.
note: ONE SOURCE: the club's own pages (sscnapoli.it). Read in full on pages headed 2026/27.

rule: The Fidelity Card "Fan Stadium Card", made with TicketOne, costs EUR 20.00 and lasts three years; it carries the holder's photo and expiry date and a barcode. It is required for a season ticket, it is the only way to buy online (tickets are loaded onto the card), and it gives a dedicated presale phase at a discounted price and reserved turnstiles. It is bought online (TicketOne account, passport-style JPEG photo, ID document data, credit card) and posted to the buyer within 15 days. It is issued only after an online Questura check: not for people under a stadium ban (DASPO), under prevention measures, or convicted (even not finally) of offences at sporting events.

rule: Season-ticket benefits 2026/27. Full: priority and a discount (on the full ticket price) for one ticket, for the holder's own seat, for each home UEFA Champions League game after the league phase and each home Coppa Italia game after the round of 16 (finals excluded); priority to buy one extra ticket, for another person with a Fan Stadium Card, for the Serie A home games against Juventus, Inter, Milan and Roma, within the seats available. rule: Tickets are strictly personal and not transferable, issued only after the holder's personal data are recorded. A valid ID document is needed at entry and must be shown on request; a ticket loaded onto the Fidelity Card also needs the seat voucher (segnaposto). rule: Fans with a 100% disability register on sscnapoli.ticketone.it/accrediti (certificate and ID), then request tickets per game; requests are accepted by availability and paid by a pay-link for two tickets (fan and an adult companion) in one transaction, sent as print-at-home. These tickets are personal, not transferable, and the companion cannot be changed. Wheelchair users: Tribuna Anello Inferiore (44 + 44 places, Gate 5), Curva A and Curva B Anello Inferiore (28 + 28 each, Gates 23 and 9, reduced tariffs for partial view); ambulant: Distinti Anello Inferiore (120 + 120, Gates 19 and 16). Disabled fans buying for other sectors are not admitted.
